name: AntBNC Lemma List (ver. 004)
creator: Laurence Anthony
description: Form -> lemma list derived from the British National Corpus (all words with frequency > 2). Distributed with AntConc/AntWordProfiler.
role: optional lemmatizer back-end for NWLC近似 (approximate parity with Mizumoto's New Word Level Checker)
delivery: bundled in the public repository; deployments can still override it via Streamlit Secrets, environment variables, or a local path.
notes: NWLC近似 only: NWLC uses an AntBNC list manually matched to JACET headwords; the raw list is close but not identical.
